title: Signature study: SLH-DSA alongside Ed25519
description: 2024 — SLH-DSA: SLH-DSA is NIST's stateless hash-based signature standard, published as FIPS-205 on 13 August 2024. alongside Ed25519 (2011), This Signature pairing study examines the two together as complementary tools in real systems. Ed25519 is a digital signature scheme using the Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm over Curve25519. Filed as JAH-CRY-000009 in the JAH Cryptography Database archive.
